week_selection.excluded_weeks: all prior development/evaluation Mondays plus every Monday within 14 calendar days of them, preventing the eight-day causal context from overlapping prior development weeks
week_selection.method: SHA-256(candidate-01-v23-calendar-mss-displacement:<0..2>) modulo the remaining ordered Monday pool, removing each selected week before the next draw; frozen before execution

execution_data: official Binance Vision aggregate trades as one-for-one TradeTick

frozen_v22_logic.information_clock: daily causal equal-notional target representing one minute of the immediately preceding completed UTC day
frozen_v22_logic.failed_sweep: same-side pivot sweep, close back inside, initiative/reversal flow sign change
frozen_v22_logic.mss: completed event close through nearer opposing pivot with aligned aggressive flow
frozen_v22_logic.target: nearest active completed-day/week high or low strictly beyond the farther local opposing pivot, selected before MSS and never selected by reward to risk
frozen_v22_logic.calendar_level_consumption: first later completed event whose range trades the level

new_execution_logic.signal: completed MSS event, without waiting for a broken-pivot retest
new_execution_logic.entry: first later venue TradeTick through NautilusTrader market bracket
new_execution_logic.confirmation_hold: entry must remain on the broken side of the internal pivot
new_execution_logic.invalidation: adverse extreme of every completed failed-sweep-to-MSS event plus unchanged 7-bps side-cost buffer

second_and_third_week_policy: run unchanged only when the preceding frozen week fully passes
long_evaluation_policy: open only after all three frozen weeks fully pass without logic or parameter changes
